## Invitations

A total of 438 people were invited to the River Districts outreach activity. Of those invited, 72 attended. This represents an attendance rate of 16.4 per cent. The figures provide a summary of invitations issued and attendance recorded for the reporting period. Attendance is reported against the number invited to support a clear comparison between outreach activity and participation.

The attendance result indicates that participation was lower than the total number invited. The rate of 16.4 per cent reflects the proportion of invited people who attended.

## Contact

No invitations were sent by SMS. The SMS total was 0. No reminder messages were issued, and the recorded reminder total was 0. Accordingly, the outreach contact recorded for this report did not include SMS invitations or reminder messages.
